horoscope: Today's Moon encourages your lighter, more spontaneous side, dear Aries. This transit is not only about escaping the ordinary, but it's also about expanding your experiences or your mind. Today's Moon-Mars opposition can find you getting worked up with a tense environment, so aim to focus and center yourself as much as possible. With an overarching Neptune-Pluto transit, you're in a generally good time for networking, connecting, and sharing. There can be lively exchanges now that inspire you and renew your spirit. You could be feeling a stronger purpose as a result of your interactions or special projects and plans. You're very willing to be of service in some way to people in your life, and this is good for the soul.

The Moon spends the day in your solar eighth house, dear Taurus, and you could be focusing on resolving an emotional or private matter. Still, watch for an overemphasis on complicated emotions that can interfere with your productivity. Energies in the first half of the day can feel too competitive or impulsive for your liking. You benefit from a longer-term transit that's strong now and this week. While you’re “going hard” in some areas of your life, this transit helps you find moments to detox, relax, decompress, and detach. It also reminds you of the value of feeding your spirit and imagination alongside your more worldly pursuits. As you pay more attention to your mental and emotional health, you gain a stronger sense of meaningfulness and purpose in your responsibilities.

Mars continues to transit your sign, dear Gemini, encouraging your independent, pioneering side. However, today's Moon stirs a strong need for companionship. Finding a balance may be challenging in the first half of the day, and others might seem to arouse defensiveness in you. However, consider that they may be showing a side of yourself or your unmet needs through your interactions. Fortunately, this week's outer-planet transits swoop in to inspire you. It's a generally good time for guidance, sharing ideas, and support. Satisfaction comes from helping others out with information or advice. You’re inspired to grow, improve, explore, discover, and move outside of your comfort zone. Friendships grow or begin. New ideas, causes, and people that inspire you. You can be thoroughly excited by and invested in a project, study, or venture, and you can make tremendous progress with this kind of dedication and focus.

You’re in a fabulous position to focus on the things you love doing, dear Cancer, and energies this week are generally strong for increased self-acceptance and enjoyment, and possibly for learning new things about yourself or someone important to you. You may tune in to greater feelings of purpose and meaningfulness. You’re looking at your life path, relationships, and projects in new ways. Business, career, and reputation get a boost, and the key to this involves extending your help, services, advice, or expertise to someone in need. The Moon spends today in your work and health sector, and the desire or need to attend to your duties and routines is in focus. You want to be useful or productive now.

In the first half of the day, sensitivity on a social level can lead to quick reactions, dear Leo, which can heat things up further. With the Moon in your sector of joy all day, expressing yourself and sharing can be a strong draw. Interactions with others may end up revealing hidden desires. With current outer-planet transits, it's a fine time for enjoying alternative activities with a partner or for connecting with someone significant through mind-expanding experiences or non-routine activities. You’re finding a greater sense of personal meaning and purpose through your contacts and explorations. You’re learning through others’ viewpoints and expanding your experiences in the process. While there can be some differences in your visions of where you're heading or long-term goals, there can be great understanding and tolerance expressed now, and this carries you.

You can feel quite motivated to bring order or harmony to your home or personal life today, dear Virgo. Even so, it might not be easy getting over frustrations in the first half of the day. Allowing irritations to motivate you to make changes or put a bothersome situation behind you can be productive. While clearing the air may seem to be what you need, there's a tendency to be too defensive to make much progress, so waiting it out may be best. Even as early as later today can be calmer. Helping can be satisfying, and you can experience new feelings of inspiration regarding your daily affairs, psychological health, or an intimate relationship. You can quickly become absorbed in what you're doing, or you might thoroughly enjoy providing a service or devoting some time helping others out.

You can be strongly attracted to personal interests today, dear Libra, with the Moon in your solar third house. In the first half of the day, however, you may find it hard to attend to all your needs and desires. Keep in mind that rushing through your tasks will more than likely lead to mistakes and disagreements with today's Moon-Mars opposition. Get in better touch with your true desires before taking action. This week's outer-planet transits are particularly strong for your relationships. You might form a creative partnership, or a connection is enhanced with increased attention to creativity, imagination, and recreation. You're looking at your projects, entertainment, the love in your life, your relationships, and your relationship needs in new ways, and you have the ability to combine your desire for intensity and need for freedom quite successfully. You're excited about drawing up plans. Relationships thrive with both tolerance and passion.

Comfort needs are strong on your mind today, dear Scorpio, with the Moon in your solar second house all day. In the first half of the day, tensions can run high regarding matters of boundaries, money, power dynamics, or respect. You can feel unsatisfied if you feel you're out of balance. Fortunately, it's easier as the day advances to settle in. Outer-planet transits strong this week are good for a greater sense of belonging or connectedness. You might improve relationships with family and co-workers through increased understanding. You could be discovering more meaning and purpose through your job, wellness programs, and family initiatives. You could find that being of service to people you love in some manner can be satisfying as well.

Differences and problem areas are in strong focus early today, dear Sagittarius, but as the day advances, you can feel quite pleased with things. In the first half of the day, you're inclined to go your own way, but you also seek acknowledgment from others, which is complicated. With current outer-planet transits strong this week, you're in particularly good shape for guiding, learning, and advising. People are drawn to you and your ideas. You may be finding more meaning and inspiration in what you’re doing, which makes everything feel more rewarding. It’s a good time to expand your mind and connect with others through the mind. Extending help or finding new things to love about someone can be a pleasant focus.

The Moon spends another day in your privacy sector, dear Capricorn, and you're not quite ready to mingle. You can certainly feel torn with the Moon's tense aspects in the first half of the day, but getting in touch with true needs and wants should be a priority. Remind yourself that you need some breathing room. As the day advances, relaxing and detoxing come more naturally, and it’s good for you! With current outer-planet transits, you're in generally good shape for finding a stronger sense of purpose or meaning through your home life, business, or family. You can accomplish far more than usual when you feel dedicated. There is excellent energy for forgiveness or acceptance in relationships, particularly with family, but this can extend to other relationships as well. It's easier to overlook the small problems and see the value of your connections overall.

While you may want to push ahead with personal plans, you could encounter resistance in the first half of today, dear Aquarius. There can be some feelings of unrest stirring, and it would be wise to sort out frustrations. You may vacillate between wanting to do something on your own and wanting others' involvement. As the day advances, you're likely to feel far more content. Expressing yourself through spontaneous, interesting, and perhaps unusual activities can be especially rewarding. You can be quite pleased with your projects, studies, and connections. You are willing to put in extra effort or to express your dedication in your relationships, and this gives things a nice boost.

The Moon spends another day in your responsibility sector, dear Pisces, and you're still in a productive, goal-oriented frame of mind. The Moon's aspects early today tend to trigger frustrations that have been working under the surface. Ideally, they help you deal with a problem area, but watch for an impatient approach that ultimately sets you back. With current outer-planet transits, you're looking at your finances, self-worth, talents, and resources in new ways. You're more imaginative with these things, ready to consider potentials and possibilities. It's a time of increased personal meaning and purpose on an emotional level, as well as through your relationship with your practical world. It can be a great time for connecting with others anonymously and resolving problems or for unloading problems through journaling or communicating on your own terms.
